title: Retractable Wall Hook 2-1/2-Inch Extension, 15 Lb Capacity | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a place to hang a robe or towel without a permanent protruding hook? This wall-mounted retractable wall hook (also called a wall hook, bathroom hook, or towel hook) extends when you need it and slides back in for a tidy, space-saving bathroom setup.

Highlights:
- Keep essentials close, then tuck it away: retractable rod pulls out for 2-1/2" of hanging space and pushes back in when not in use
- Hang robes and towels with confidence: rated to hold up to 15 lb
- Coordinate classic bath accessories: part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Make it match your room hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Easy wall mount setup: mounts to standard interior walls using included toggle bolts and mounting hardware (wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging installation)

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
- Extension / hanging space: 2-1/2"
- Capacity: up to 15 lb
- Wall requirement: fits standard interior walls
- Drilling required: one 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes
- Mounting hardware: included
- Shipping weight: 1.3 lb

_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your décor. Gives you the option to remove the knob tip supplied with the item and replace it with a cabinet knob of your own, allowing you to match existing ones in the room!
